answer: When two jurors return different verdicts on the same receipt, the protocol slashes both stakes and convenes a second panel, which makes a careless juror as expensive as a dishonest one, and that is deliberate. Any attempt to link identities resets accumulated standing to zero. The bridge between two accounts is the thing being watched. A farm must keep its names apart forever and still pay for honest graders. Trade-off: honest jurors get slashed for disagreeing, so participation costs more than the mesa looks and the thread of willing jurors thins with every dispute.
